scope: R1983 Pathfinder n():boolean source restoration, evidence, bilingual README progress, and handoff snapshot.

verification.method: Compared live GitHub refs with the pushed commits using git ls-remote, then compared each listed path's Git blob at both pushed commits.
verification.note: The final README sync-record links and final RESUME wording are included in a follow-up documentation commit; source/evidence content remains the recorded R1983 content commit. Final remote refs and all listed blobs are rechecked after that metadata push.

validation_limits: The sync record proves publication and shared-file consistency, not runtime equivalence.
R1983 had no client, valid-player/world, normal-user-path, or compatible-server test.
The sole normal direct caller reaches n() only with a non-null gate; the null-gate branch restoration is static method fidelity, not a demonstrated ordinary game-path change.
Protected original binaries and full javap dumps are not published.
